name: Mall Stair Tread Light
description: A narrow recessed riser light has a satin nickel flange, three downward-folded graphite baffles and a warm diffuser visible between the blades.
accuracy_notes: The riser opening needs clearance for the rear can. The baffles depict downward shielding; output and glare have not been photometrically evaluated.
